register.evidence: phase-4 ui.matrix_pass_is (runtime CSV, last-write-wins conftest.py:85/575); 236 dialog + 131 act_* over-claimed rows
register.remediation: Live RTM enforcement: a matrix cell is 'pass' only if the owning test RAN and ASSERTED in the CI run that produced the CSV; forbid rebuilding the matrix from committed green; make SKIP clobbering impossible (owner-only writes) (SC-f).

register.location: visual oracles: tests/visual/diff.py, tests/ui_harness/core/golden.py, test_ui_annotations.py, test_ui_page_operations.py
register.description: PrintWindow/SSIM/pixel_diff/golden mechanisms exist but goldens self-seed (regen_golden), thresholds are relaxed (SSIM>=0.85), and the dominant assertion is a CHANGE-detector (SSIM<0.95 OR pixel_diff>=0.0001 == 'changed' == pass) rather than a correctness oracle.
register.exemplar_escape: Canvas renders MIRRORED / wrong-zoom / half-size / tofu glyphs / wrong icon -- the change-detector sees a diff and PASSES; a self-seeded golden makes a plausible-looking wrong render indistinguishable from correct.
register.failure_missed: The exact shipped mirror/half-size/wrong-orientation render class passes the UI visual layer because 'it changed' is treated as 'it's correct'.
register.evidence: phase-4 ui.visual_mechanisms + invisible_regression_classes (mirror/zoom/tofu/wrong-icon); self-seeding goldens, relaxed thresholds
register.remediation: Commit correctness goldens produced by a trusted reference (not regen-from-current); assert against a known-correct baseline, not merely 'differs from before'; tighten thresholds for orientation/scale-sensitive views (SC-g).

register.location: lifecycle/teardown: tests/test_save_throw_undo_safety.cpp:286 (nearest existing); no window-close-mid-active-edit test
register.description: There is no test that destroys the application/document while an edit or tool is active. The nearest coverage (save-that-throws undo rebind) is EXPECT_NO_THROW-only and only a hard crash on ASan fails it; on Debug/Release a logic-corrupting rebind passes. No test drives real window-close during an in-flight edit.
register.exemplar_escape: Seed 2: crash-on-close mid-edit (no destruction-under-active-state test). The shipped ~MainWindow mid-edit teardown 0xC0000005 UAF class.
register.failure_missed: The app crashes (UAF) when the user closes the window while a text/annotation edit is active; no test catches it outside an ASan hard-crash.
register.evidence: phase-1 test_save_throw_undo_safety.cpp:286 (only-ASan-crash-fails); seed 2; memory pipeline_a3f8e21d (mid-edit teardown UAF)
register.remediation: Add a destruction-under-active-state test matrix (close window / destroy document while each edit family + tool is active) run under ASan, asserting clean teardown; partial today -- only the save-throw sub-case exists.

register.description: OCR's user-visible truth is the recognized text; the oracle checks hocr non-empty + blocks>0. Gibberish recognition passes because no known word from the scanned fixture is asserted present; a DPI regression (RenderPageAt300Dpi accepts >100px) silently degrades OCR input.
register.exemplar_escape: OCR mis-recognizes the page into gibberish and passes.
register.failure_missed: User OCRs a scan and gets unusable text while the suite is green.
register.evidence: phase-1 test_ocr_pipeline.cpp:190; phase-2 top_uncovered_capabilities (OCR recognition quality)
register.remediation: Assert a known word/string from the fixture appears in the hOCR; pin the render-DPI to a tolerance band.

register.description: PDF/A and compliance scanners are tested only against clean fixtures asserting the scanner reports NOTHING; a scanner that always returns false/empty (never detects encryption/JS/external-refs) passes every test. XMP pdfaid part/conformance verified by substring-anywhere.
register.exemplar_escape: A broken ProhibitedFeatureScanner silently passes non-compliant documents; a malformed pdfaid (part=3) passes.
register.failure_missed: Non-compliant / mislabelled PDF/A documents pass validation and are delivered as compliant; green.
register.evidence: phase-1 test_prohibited_feature_scanner.cpp:39, test_xmp_metadata_writer.cpp:50, test_font_compliance_checker.cpp:96
register.remediation: Add positive-detection fixtures (a doc WITH encryption/JS/external-ref) and assert the scanner flags each; assert pdfaid part/conformance at the correct XML node, not substring-anywhere.

register.description: Optimize (garbage=4) can leave stale/deleted form-field values or removed content embedded; the test reopens and asserts only pageCount>0, so the exact data-leak the test is named for ships green. (Related to R-08 gc-downgrade M09.)
register.exemplar_escape: Deleted form-field values remain recoverable in the optimized output.
register.failure_missed: A user 'removes' content and optimizes, but the content survives in the file; green.
register.evidence: phase-1 test_optimize.cpp:175; phase-2 top_uncovered_capabilities (Optimize deleted-content leak); phase-3 M09
register.remediation: Assert the deleted value's bytes are ABSENT from the decompressed optimized stream (a real byte-absence oracle, as with redaction).

register.location: GAP-A15 exit-code masking: pdfe_tests.exe exit code vs JUnit XML; windows-validation.yml JUnit parse
register.description: pdfe_tests.exe can exit 0 while the JUnit XML records failures (tell-tale: tests != passed+skipped). Now DEFENDED in CI (XML sum-of-failures parsed, not exit code) and honored in phase-3 mutation runs; registered as the residual standing requirement so the defense is never removed.
register.exemplar_escape: Seed 5: GAP-A15 exit-code masking (CI integrity) -- the original escape where a green exit code hid failing tests.
register.failure_missed: If the JUnit-parse step is ever removed, a failing suite reports success on exit code alone.
register.evidence: phase-4 process gap_a15_junit_parsed_in_ci=true; phase-3 test_runner_evidence.junit_xml_parsed_all=true; gtest_exit_code_masking memory
register.remediation: Keep the JUnit sum-of-failures check as a required, non-removable CI step; add a self-test that a deliberately-failing sentinel fails the build (SC-h).

register.description: The gate-reliability fix is REAL (verdicts derive from artifacts + parsed JUnit XML, no forgery allow-list). Residual: karen/validator/security-audit emit PASS with no independent evidence of their own; the hook only re-checks the test-runner XML, so a judgment gate can falsely bless a phase whose tests are green but whose acceptance criteria were not truly met.
register.exemplar_escape: Seed 6: gate fabrication (governance) -- now structurally prevented for test-backed verdicts; the residual honor-system exposure is the judgment gates.
register.failure_missed: A judgment gate signs off a phase that passes tests but does not meet acceptance criteria.
register.evidence: phase-4 process gate_verdict_source=artifact, forgery_allowlist_present=false, 'Judgment-gate verdict is honor-system (bounded)'
register.remediation: Require judgment gates to cite machine-checkable evidence (specific acceptance-criterion artifacts) in their verdict payload; keep the red-XML veto as the hard floor.

register.description: Coverage is best-effort: continue-on-error:true, silently skipped when the tool is absent, gated by NO floor. It produces an artifact but can never fail the build, so coverage regressions are invisible.
register.exemplar_escape: A new untested subsystem (or a deleted test) drops coverage with no CI signal.
register.failure_missed: Coverage silently erodes; the artifact exists but enforces nothing.
register.evidence: phase-4 process coverage_floor_enforced=false; windows-validation.yml:346-374
register.remediation: Enforce a per-subsystem coverage floor that fails the build on regression; make the tool's absence a hard error, not a silent skip (SC-d).

register.location: hostile-input-matrix zero classes + adversarial fixture backlog
register.description: 4 of 38 hostile-input classes have ZERO fixture coverage: sheared/skewed CTM in content-stream (the direct geometric sibling of the -100 Tz mirror bug this audit exists for), 0-page document, 10k-page scale boundary, combining-marks/ZWJ/grapheme clusters. The adversarial-ambient corpus has half-SCALE cm but no shear.
register.exemplar_escape: An injector that fails to reset a sheared ambient CTM emits slanted/parallelogram text/images -- untested; a legally-empty (0-page) doc crashes page(0)-assuming paths.
register.failure_missed: Slanted/parallelogram edits on sheared-CTM pages, crash on 0-page docs, O(n^2) blowup at 10k pages, delete-half-a-grapheme corruption -- no red test today.
register.evidence: phase-2 zero_coverage_hostile_classes (4); consolidated_adversarial_fixture_backlog (shear/rotated/mediabox-offset/grapheme/0-page/10k)
register.remediation: Add the phase-2 fixture backlog (aa_shear.pdf, aa_img_shear.pdf, rotated-edit, mediabox-offset, grapheme_clusters, zero_page, 10000page) and feed each through the injectors with the SC-a pixel/quad oracles.

register.description: The macOS validation lane runs only PreflightOpen.*/PreflightXPlatform.* (a handful of isolation-boundary tests), not the full suite, so one of three advertised platforms provides almost no regression coverage.
register.exemplar_escape: A macOS-specific regression outside the preflight subset ships green because the macOS lane never exercises the rest of the suite.
register.failure_missed: Any macOS-only defect in the ~4360 tests outside the preflight subset is invisible on the macOS lane.
register.evidence: phase-4 process-critique.json finding 'macOS validation is a thin subset' (macos-validation.yml:118-120)
register.remediation: Run the full (or a representative core) suite on the macOS lane, or drop the platform's advertised support claim to match reality.

register.location: fixture catalog: 200 fixtures, 32 orphan, 1 missing-referenced; flaw_corpus (47) all -> one open-only smoke test
register.description: Adversarial breadth exists but adversarial DEPTH per product-path is thin: 32 orphan fixtures are unreferenced by any test, and the 47-fixture flaw corpus all feed a single open-only smoke test (an open-parse pass is not a save/redact/render pass).
register.exemplar_escape: A fixture crafted to stress the save/redact/render path is only ever opened, so the deeper path it was built for is never exercised.
register.failure_missed: Adversarial inputs prove open() survives but never prove save/redact/render survive; orphan fixtures test nothing.
register.evidence: phase-2 fixture_totals.orphan=32, missing_referenced=1; cross_validation (flaw_corpus open-only)
register.remediation: Wire orphan fixtures to a consumer test on their intended product path; extend the flaw corpus beyond open() to save/redact/render depth passes.

register.description: Rerun-on-failure exists but known-flaky tests (PerfStressTest.TenThousandAnnotationsOnePage, MainWindowIntegrationTest.ZoomComboExists) are tracked only in inline comments — there is no machine-readable quarantine/xfail registry, so a test degrading from reliable to flaky is not a first-class signal and reruns can mask a slowly-worsening test.
register.exemplar_escape: A test that silently drifts from reliable to intermittently-failing is absorbed by rerun-on-failure and never flagged as degrading.
register.failure_missed: A slowly-worsening test (eventually a real regression) is masked by reruns with no quarantine ledger to surface the trend.
register.evidence: phase-4 process-critique.json finding 'No formal flaky quarantine ledger' (census.json:451; windows-validation.yml:291-304)
register.remediation: Add a machine-readable flaky-quarantine/xfail registry with an entry+owner+expiry per known-flaky test; fail CI when an unregistered test flakes.
